policy.combination: Only disjoint components within the same published measured profile; display-name matches are not profile equivalence.
policy.missing: Unmeasured, never a failure. Partial rows have no overall score or rank.
policy.protocols: Historical source versions and per-wave settings retained; these are reused measurements, not new complete runs. A wave21 component taken from a fresh run carries its own source version and profile note.
policy.incompatible_pairs: Historical DeepAgents GLM/DeepSeek enabled native subagents; new wave21 disabled them. Keep separate profiles. 80/160 graph steps and model API request caps are distinct.
policy.controls: Forty wave20 controls and ten unselected calibration tasks excluded from Medium90.
